description: This file defines an abstract base class for univariate root solvers in the Apache Commons Math library. It provides common implementation details for solvers, including configuration, evaluation, bracketing checks, and setup routines, meant to be extended by specific solver implementations.

classes.name: BaseAbstractUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for univariate root-finding algorithms in the Apache Commons Math library, including configuration management, evaluation counting, and utility checks, to be extended by concrete solver implementations.

methods.name: getMaxEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of function evaluations allowed.

methods.name: getEvaluations
methods.description: Returns the count of function evaluations performed so far.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the search interval.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the search interval.

methods.name: getStartValue
methods.description: Returns the initial starting point for the solver.

methods.name: getAbsoluteAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the absolute accuracy used for convergence.

methods.name: getRelativeAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the relative accuracy used for convergence.

methods.name: getFunctionValueAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed error in function value.

methods.name: computeObjectiveValue
methods.description: Evaluates the objective function at a given point, incrementing evaluation count.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the solver with the function, interval bounds, initial guess, and maximum evaluations, resetting counts.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Executes the root-finding algorithm with various parameter options, initializing configuration.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses with the actual solving logic.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks if the function values have opposite signs at two points.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Checks if three numbers are in a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Verifies that two points define a valid interval.

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Verifies that three points are in a valid sequence with the middle between the other two.

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Checks that an interval brackets a root, with the function having opposite signs at the endpoints.

methods.name: incrementEvaluationCount
methods.description: Increments the count of function evaluations and throws exception if maximum is exceeded.
